name: PIKE, Henry Jon

headline.note: Official records identify employment from 2014 to 2021 with two member-funded industry advocacy bodies: the Queensland Farmers' Federation and Property Council of Australia. Employer-association work is excluded from the public/private headline measure. Published sources do not establish pre-2014 employment, hours, leave, exact 2014–15 transition dates or the 2021 cessation before campaigning and election. Party roles, study and elected office are also excluded, so no headline total is calculated.

career_spells.employer: University of Canberra and University of Queensland
career_spells.role: Bachelor of Applied Science (Architecture) and Master of Business Administration student
career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies list both qualifications but no attendance, completion or employment-overlap dates.

The official biography identifies the role and year. QFF describes itself as the peak body for agricultural member organisations and the charity register identifies the entity as a charity. Exact appointment/cessation, hours, leave and transition to the Property Council are unpublished.
career_spells.counting_note: Employment by a member-funded peak body is employer-association work and excluded.

career_spells.role: Communications and Policy Officer / Senior Policy and Communications Adviser, Queensland
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives policy-adviser work from 2015 to 2021. A Property Council announcement identifies Pike as a new Queensland communications and policy officer on 25 August 2015; a 2019 employer release identifies him as senior adviser. Exact start day, role boundary, hours and leave are unpublished.
career_spells.counting_note: Property Council is an industry/employer advocacy body, so the employment is excluded.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biography supplies the role and year. Property Council media releases identify Pike as media contact during 2021, but exact promotion/cessation, hours, leave and overlap with preselection are not stated.

career_spells.employer: Liberal Party of Australia / Liberal National Party of Queensland
career_spells.role: Federal Young Liberals Vice-President; LNP Metro South Region Branch Chair
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography lists federal Young Liberal vice-president in 2013 and LNP regional branch chair in 2021. Paid status, exact dates and hours are unspecified.
Official records show election to the House of Representatives for Bowman on 21 May 2022.
